text:
Alex: Heads up - ACME partner asked us to freeze driver/CUDA/ROCm versions for their marketplace image prior to joint announcement next Tue. They want a signed compatibility matrix and a rollback plan.
Maria: Got it. Do they require CUDA 12.3 or is 12.2 acceptable?
Alex: They said '12.x certified' but flagged a perf regression on 12.3 in their testing notes. Asking us to recommend a pinned combo.
Zheng: We reproduced a latency delta on A100 with CUDA 12.3 + driver 535 on long context runs. Short summary: CUDA 12.2 + driver 520 is the most stable in our infra.
Sam: @Zheng can you paste the minimal repro + observed metric so partners can run it?
Zheng: Sure - snippet: ```bash
# repro loop
python perf_test.py --model gpt-j --seq 2048 --batch 8 --iters 100
# observed: p50 latency ~+18% on 12.3/535 vs 12.2/520
```
Nina: Partner compliance wants a signed PDF matrix and a one-page hotfix playbook (what to do if regression hits GA). Can we deliver both by EOD Fri?
Maria: EOD Fri is tight but doable if we split tasks. I can draft matrix + partner comms. @Alex can you own verification checklist and canary runs?
Alex: I'll trigger a canary across staging and Dedicated pools now. @OpsBot kick it off.
OpsBot: Canary job queued: canary-run-4929123456 on pools (staging,dedicated). ETA ~40m. Logs: https://redwood.ci/canaries/4929123456
Sam: I'll draft rollback steps and kernel/driver pin commands. Proposal: pin driver to 520.x and CUDA to 12.2, provide an opt-in experimental 12.3 channel.
Zheng: +1. Add telemetry hook: if p50 latency increases >10% for 5 minutes, auto-fallback to 12.2/520 image. We have a rollout script to adapt.
Maria: Deliverables: 1) compatibility matrix PDF 2) one-page hotfix playbook 3) partner-facing comms blurb. Draft by Fri 5pm PT.
Alex: Canary finished: staging/Dedicated show no regression on 12.2/520. 12.3/535 reproduces perf delta. Logs in canary link.
Nina: Partner also asked for a nightly smoke plan for the 7 days after announcement. Can we commit to 7-day post-GA monitoring?
Sam: Yes - schedule 30m daily smoke runs and a daily digest. I'll add ops runbook entries.
Maria: Action items: Maria -> drafts PDFs + blurb (due Fri EOD); Alex -> verification checklist + canary results (today); Sam -> rollback/runbook + daily smoke schedule (tomorrow); Zheng -> attach repro and telemetry thresholds (today); Nina -> coordinate partner comms and confirm acceptance.
Alex: Assigned owners in the doc. Please @mention when you update so I can sign off.
Nina: I'll confirm with ACME that the proposed pin (CUDA 12.2, driver 520.x) is acceptable and loop PM/legal for signoff. :thumbsup:
Maria: Include exact image tags we will publish, e.g. `redwood/runtime:cuda12.2-driver520-rc1` so partners can pin.
Zheng: Add FAQ: "Why not 12.3?" with perf link and mitigation steps.
Sam: If partner requests hotfix cadence, propose a 48-72h emergency window for driver hotpatches with partner PMs looped.
Nina: Thanks team. I'll post partner signoff once received.
Alex: If partner pushes 12.3 we reconvene; otherwise ship matrix and playbook.
